items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps the routine kind to oily, sensitive-feeling skin while the retinol settles in.
A lower-strength 0.3% retinol is a sensible starting point for softening the look of fine lines.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports the skin's comfort and moisture without feeling heavy on oily skin.
A mineral SPF 50 is a gentle daily choice for fair, sensitive skin and is needed alongside retinol.

response.routine_note: Use the retinol at night 2 nights a week after cleansing, moisturize on top, then add a night every week or two as skin feels comfortable, and apply sunscreen every morning. Skip other exfoliating acids or scrubs on the same routine while you get started.
